summary: Iteration 14: Tested Excel report export (3 sheets, date/branch filters) and plan-history tracking (assign creates entry, GET /api/plans/history sorted desc, SuperAdmin gating). 11/11 backend pytest PASS. Frontend: ReportsPage Excel button visible with Download icon, click triggers .xlsx download (file 'reporte_2026-04-01_2026-04-25.xlsx' downloaded successfully). AdminOpticasPage shows 'Historial Plan' tab; clicking Altavista renders 4 timeline entries with ArrowRight icon, old/new plan badges, ISO date+time, and 'por Super Administrador'. Both new features fully functional end-to-end.

minor.issue: plan_history.changed_by uses user['_id'] but other code paths use user.get('_id')/str. Inconsistent. Cosmetic - works in tests.

branch_id query param is read; if user already has branch_id assigned (sub-admin), the query param can override their scope only because it later assigns via ObjectId(branch_id). No 403 if a non-admin user passes branch_id of another branch in same company. Low priority but worth a check.

backend: TestExcelExport::test_export_excel_returns_xlsx (200, correct mime, PK signature, attachment header)
TestPlanHistory::test_get_history_superadmin (sorted desc, fields present, _id serialized as string)
TestPlanHistory::test_assign_plan_creates_history_entry (count grows by 2 after Free->Enterprise round-trip; new_plan_name, changed_by_name, changed_at present)
frontend: ReportsPage Excel button visible with Download icon, label 'Excel'
Click Excel -> browser download triggered, filename ends with .xlsx (reporte_2026-04-01_2026-04-25.xlsx)
AdminOpticasPage shows 'Historial Plan' tab in detail view (data-testid=tab-plan-history)
Plan history timeline renders 4 entries for Altavista with ArrowRight icon between old/new badges
Each entry shows ISO datetime and 'por Super Administrador' (changed_by_name)

action_items: [OPTIONAL] Standardize ObjectId try/except wrapping across plans.py routes (carry-over from iter 13)
[OPTIONAL] Verify branch_id authorization in /api/reports/export/excel: a non-admin with branch scope should not be able to override branch_id via query param to access another branch's data.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/reports.py export_reports_excel: when user has its own branch_id, code only restricts via that branch but does NOT validate that a passed branch_id belongs to the same company as user.company_id - small data-leak risk if user passes branch_id of another company's branch (since query also has company_id filter, it would just return empty data, so risk is low but worth a 403/400 if mismatch).

/app/backend/routes/plans.py assign_plan: uses user['_id'] directly; if get_current_user returns id without '_id' key in some path, this would 500. Most other routes use user.get('_id'). Defensive .get() preferred.
/app/frontend/src/pages/AdminOpticasPage.js: planHistory keyed by h._id || idx; works since backend serializes _id as string. Good.
seed_data_creation: Test created 2 transient plan_history entries on Altavista (Enterprise->Free, Free->Enterprise) - persists in DB but harmless. Existing 4 entries observed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Excel export endpoint: GET /api/reports/export/excel?date_from&date_to&branch_id, blocks superadmin (403), returns xlsx with 3 sheets (Resumen/Ventas/Finanzas). Plan history endpoint: GET /api/plans/history/{company_id} (superadmin only). assign_plan inserts into plan_history with old_plan_name/new_plan_name/changed_by_name/changed_at. Frontend: ReportsPage data-testid='export-excel-btn'; AdminOpticasPage data-testid='tab-plan-history' and 'plan-history-{idx}'. Altavista has 4+ plan history entries from prior tests.
